samples.label: Live Markdown editor
samples.description: Binds a textarea to a signal and renders it with <markdown [data]>. The first run downloads Angular (~1.2 MB).

samples.label: Prism, emoji, KaTeX and DOMPurify
samples.description: Enables withPrism() and withEmoji() with their global scripts from jsDelivr, loads KaTeX and DOMPurify on demand (withKatex({ loader }), withDomPurify()), and toggles each plugin per component.

samples.label: Pipe and MarkdownService
samples.description: Renders a note with the markdown pipe and builds a table of contents and the raw HTML with MarkdownService.parse().

samples.label: Source loader and resolveUrl
samples.description: Serves the src pages from the files of the sample with a custom MARKDOWN_SOURCE_LOADER (a missing page fails with a MarkdownSourceError), and rewrites each link and image with the baseUrl resolveUrl hook, listing the resolved URLs.
